verdict_reason: Grouping by code is correct, but the species label is now read straight from the field even though three label functions already exist.

todos.issue: The species label is read from entry.speciesLatinName directly here (speciesText, line 6) and in validation/count-drop.js:24, while the same feature already has owners for how a species is labelled: speciesLabelFor in search/view-model/labels.js, speciesLatinNameOf in check-answers/.../species-latin-name.js (falls back to ''), and speciesName in commodities/species-name.js. The PR replaced commodities.speciesLabel with raw field reads, so the species-block heading and the count-drop error no longer go through any label function and will drift from the search page if the label rule changes.
todos.fix: Must: the Latin-name species label shown on the consignment-details page (block heading and count-drop error) comes from the same function the search page and check-answers use. One way: call speciesLatinNameOf(entry) (or move speciesLabelFor beside speciesName in commodities/ and use it) in groupLine and countDropIssueFor.
